clips.title: The story
paras: Blackrock orcs hold a small camp in the southeastern Redridge Mountains at Render's Valley. It threatens nearby travelers and keeps captives taken from surrounding lands.

Render's Valley lies among rocky ridges southeast of Lake Everstill, where Blackrock orcs keep an auxiliary camp for their operations in Redridge. Unlike the fortified keeps and stone towers on the northern cliffs, this camp gathers around war tents, banners, and sentry posts. Its warriors are smaller in number and less armed than the clan's core forces, but they still raid local roads and harass travelers. Captured prisoners remain in crude cages under guard.

Scouts who reach Render's Valley find unexpected points of interest beyond the war parties roaming its dirt paths. Human prisoners have been seen in the camp, including a servant connected to the Tower of Azora who traded specialist goods under his captors' noses. Unmarked paths cross the high southern bluffs behind the valley, letting daring travelers slip into the murky bogs of the Swamp of Sorrows.
